item.title: The many lives of Toronto’s historic Paradise Theatre
item.description: Paradise Theatre in Toronto's Bloorcourt neighbourhood has lived many lives over the last century, and if its walls could talk, they'd probably tell a story as dramatic as any film that's ever screened there.Situated at 1006 Bloor Street W., the landmark property first opened back in 1910 as simply Bloor Palace, a one-storey brick theatre serving the fast-growing community.
